description.zh: 需要进行批量配置的域名。取值可以是推流域名、主播流域名或子播流域名。多个域名用英文逗号（,）分隔。
description.en: The domain names that you want to batch configure. Supported domain names include ingest domains, main streaming domains, and sub-streaming domains. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,).

description.zh:
功能列表。

某些功能，如`filetype_based_ttl_set`，可以设置多条记录，当需要更新其中某条记录时，可通过该条记录的`configId`来指定。更多信息，请参见下表**Function格式说明**和**Functions功能说明**。
description.en:
The list of features.

Some features, such as `filetype_based_ttl_set`, support multiple configuration records. To update one of the configuration records, use `configId` to identify the record. For more information, see **Format of the Functions parameter** and **Features specified by the Functions parameter**.

descriptions.zh:
先获取需要进行配置的直播域名，再调用本接口批量配置域名。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为30次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
Obtain the domain names that you want to configure, and then call this operation to configure the domain names in batches.

## [](#qps-)QPS limit

You can call this operation up to 30 times per second per account. Requests that exceed this limit are dropped and you will experience service interruptions. We recommend that you take note of this limit when you call this operation.
